result_and_question_links.title: Necessary Being and the typed original-bearer bridge
result_and_question_links.report_section: From an original resource to the same necessary bearer
result_and_question_links.contribution: Inherited source case distinguishes concrete sufficiency, received existence and necessity. T20 formalises typed original resource→same bearer, then separately exposes contingency-as-need, constitutive transport and representation assumptions.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: Provisional sufficient-warrant Necessary Being acceptance remains philosophical; this audit reruns no Lean proof and the sources do not supply a modern exhaustive ontology by citation alone.

result_and_question_links.title: Causal nonduplication and essentiality transfer
result_and_question_links.contribution: Source ideas of original power, inseparable qualification and concrete bearer constrain a new conditional transfer audit. CND alone does not entail essential nonreceipt; original-role retention and receipt-to-same-contribution overlap do further work.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: No fresh warrant for every formal premise and no new independent English-source reading; the 61-page Arabic revisit is part of the same previously studied Arabic witness.

result_and_question_links.title: Connected creation and the actual common-source appraisal
result_and_question_links.report_section: From a qualified source to common field provision; Current philosophical assessment

source_links.locator: PDF 24–47, especially 37–40; notes 19 and 32 at 33 and 47

result_and_question_links.contribution: The supplied Oneness argument already includes connected creation, compatible cooperation and fuller cited replies. T20’s exact same-object reread and Arabic contextual checks prevent describing that case as a mere disagreement dilemma or a newly discovered argument.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: At 14:34 UTC the actual field-bounded common-source claim is provisionally accepted at lower confidence than Necessary Being; universal SourceMode remains withheld. Historical T17–T19 and earlier T20 judgements remain dated and unchanged. Conditional incidence proofs do not resolve their application premises.

result_and_question_links.title: Perfection ascent versus thin original ground
result_and_question_links.report_section: Original ground and the limits of observation
result_and_question_links.contribution: The sources have broader pure-perfection and original-giver arguments. A thin powerless model therefore tests only a thin interface and does not refute those additional premises. Reified necessary-bearer language and mere nonobjectual fact language must be distinguished.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: Standing capacity and actual efficient provision remain different conclusions. Finite interpretations establish declared relative consistency, not metaphysical possibility or the whole philosophical attribute profile.

result_and_question_links.title: Source-owned veracity and the ownership boundary
result_and_question_links.contribution: The T20 premise map expressly cites inherited T17 guide P00107 and P00109 for practical conformance and wisdom. Relevant knowledge, awareness/control, shortcoming classification, all-context fittingness and actual conformance remain separate.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: Historical T17 essential-T0 acceptance is not erased, but this audit supplies no new warrant for it. A productive source is not automatically the speaker of a creature’s assertion, and truthfulness does not authenticate an alleged revelation.

result_and_question_links.title: Basic recognition and sufficient warrant
result_and_question_links.contribution: The historical sources claim actual Creator-knowledge, while Turner’s proper-function construction has its own explicit conditional scope. Relatively basic knowledge need not await a prior complete theory of reliability.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: T20 accepts epistemological admissibility of warranted basic Creator-recognition, not an independently certified universal empirical faculty or every particular recognition. Repeated MF 6:73 references are one overlapping source family.

result_and_question_links.title: Cumulative testimony and shared-source copying
result_and_question_links.report_section: Grounded testimony and warranted continuation; Deletion traces and copied observations
result_and_question_links.contribution: The sources motivate qualitative, contextual and dependence-sensitive testimony assessment. Shared roots, adapted versions and copied observations cannot be treated as fresh independent support. This is a conceptual relation to the T20 formal provenance work.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: The finite support/alias-cut and deletion-channel theorems are T20 mathematical work with their own evidence; they are not theorems proved by these theological books and do not infer the actual root map.

result_and_question_links.title: Numerical illustrations and model-specific validation
result_and_question_links.contribution: Prior corrections distinguish a digit from a full four-digit code, 10^10 from one billion, with-replacement from without-replacement draws, and small positive probability from impossibility. Their model-specific status is a control against decorative numerical authority.
result_and_question_links.current_boundary: Inherited findings, not new T20 discoveries, independent source experiments, or disproof of the separate causal/recognitional arguments. No new scientific literature validation is claimed.

result_and_question_links.title: Translation and editorial apparatus controls

result_and_question_links.current_boundary: No new discovery credit for the diagram problem; no complete translation reliability verdict, resolved translator ancestry or new manuscript collation.
